enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_UNCATEGORIZED_EXT
enum.comment: The runtime was unable to classify the vertex or triangle.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_FLOOR_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a floor.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_WALL_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a wall.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CEILING_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a ceiling.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_TABLE_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a table.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_CHAIR_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a chair.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_SOFA_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a sofa.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_MESH_SEMANTIC_LABEL_BED_EXT
enum.comment: The vertex or triangle maps to a bed.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_MESH_TRACKING_EXT
enum.comment: Capability to track the mesh of an environment.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_CAPABILITY_FEATURE_TRACK_WATERTIGHT_MESH_EXT
enum.comment: Capability feature to track a watertight mesh of the environment. Corresponding config structure is slink:XrSpatialFeatureTrackWatertightMeshEXT.

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_MESH_3D_NORMALS_EXT
enum.comment: Component that provides the normals for the 3D mesh of a spatial entity. Corresponding list structure is slink:XrSpatialComponentMesh3DNormalsListEXT; Corresponding data structure is slink:XrSpatialBufferEXT

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_MESH_3D_VERTEX_SEMANTIC_LABELS_EXT
enum.comment: Component that provides the per-vertex semantic labels for the 3D mesh of a spatial entity. Corresponding list structure is slink:XrSpatialComponentMesh3DVertexSemanticLabelsListEXT; Corresponding data structure is slink:XrSpatialBufferEXT; Data within the buffer maps to elink:XrSpatialMeshSemanticLabelEXT

enum.name: XR_SPATIAL_COMPONENT_TYPE_MESH_3D_TRIANGLE_SEMANTIC_LABELS_EXT
enum.comment: Component that provides the per-triangle-face semantic labels for the 3D mesh of a spatial entity. Corresponding list structure is slink:XrSpatialComponentMesh3DTriangleSemanticLabelsListEXT; Corresponding data structure is slink:XrSpatialBufferEXT; Data within the buffer maps to elink:XrSpatialMeshSemanticLabelEXT
